title: VERY ATTRACTIVE SET WITH NICE STORAGE BOX
text: VERY ATTRACTIVE SET WITH NICE STORAGE BOX. My wife likes nice things and is picky about quality.  She looked at this set and immediately thought it was a very attractive set.  It also comes in a nice quality polished wooden box.  This would make a gorgeous gift that you can buy for under $50 and it looks elegant and not cheap.  I had expected a flimsy, low quality box that the silver would come in, but was pleasantly surprised that the box appears to be very well made.  It is only service for 6, so I would suggest buying two sets if you want more than 6 place settings.  For the price, it seems as if it would be hard to find a comparable set.
